_comment: Central flat-pT Herwig7 CH3 QCD (pT-hat 15-7000, STANDALONE shower, no MadGraph, no MLM merging), 2018, dijet minimal_rho on CERN lxplus HTCondor via dask-lxplus (2026-09-17; the LPC pool was saturated and coffea-casa down). Purpose: test whether the pT drift of the soft-drop groomed mass in the MLM+Herwig7 samples is made by the merging (compare Flat-Herwig7/Flat-Pythia8 against MLM-Herwig7/MLM-Pythia8 per pT bin). Nominal only (no_syst). genWeight is the pT-hat weight, normalized by the on-the-fly sumw. Everything else mirrors dijet_herwig_2018_minimal_rho_lpc.json so the axes match the production pickles: processor-default pair_split selection, the 2026-08-27 aligned groomed rho lattice and the 185 GeV pT sink. The fileset's root://cmsxrootd.fnal.gov URLs are re-routed through root://cms-xrd-global.cern.ch by build_hadronic_fileset (redirector=lxplus); the samples sit at CCIN2P3/RAL/RWTH (Herwig) and CNAF/DESY/FNAL (Pythia). Fixed pool via DASK_LXPLUS_WORKERS in the launcher. Output stages as unfold_inputs/dijet/rho/original/2018/dijet_flat_herwig/.
